session.title: Switchy 1.0.25-1.0.26: rotation by weekly reset; Codex continuation turns after a usage limit; control routes; installs on another user's PC and the laptop
session.purpose: the user: install the latest Switchy on another user's PC and his laptop remotely; rotation never switched back to an account rotated out for its five-hour limit, though its weekly quota should be used before its reset; push and release; a Codex session stopped on 'Invalid previous_response_id' after an account hit its limit; build an API route to the live app; continue the stopped session; hand off.
outcomes: Installed 1.0.24 from the GitHub release through the windows-mcp mesh: another user's PC DESKTOP-EFPDEDI from 1.0.22 (stopped, /S, relaunched; proxy was off and stays off), laptop LAPTOP-QNITDAQN from 1.0.18 (installed only; Switchy was not running there and was not started). Neither has 1.0.25 or 1.0.26.

Rotation (1.0.25, commit c57582ff): the switching order put the current provider first (get_failover_queue ORDER BY is_current DESC), so an account rotated out for its five-hour window stayed behind its replacement. order_by_quota now orders accounts not at their limit by their longest account-wide (weekly) window's reset, soonest first; accounts with no running reading follow in queue order; spent accounts go last. A switch for that reason is recorded as 'recovered' with detail "Another account's weekly limit resets sooner" (rotation_reason, used by forwarder.rs and codex_ws.rs). Covered by a unit test; not seen on live traffic yet. Decision log 2026-10-08.
postbuild.mjs now prunes superseded Windows installers from installers/ once the current one is promoted; installers/ holds only the current exe, msi and dmg.

Codex 'Invalid previous_response_id' (2026-10-09 00:38:44): account f7649e3f refused a turn for usage and the relay resent the same response.create on cc696ff2; it carried previous_response_id, valid only on the refusing connection. 1.0.26 (commit 8c5202ba): such a turn is not resent; the relay closes the connection without passing the refusal, and Codex (per its source, a closed connection resets its websocket session) retries the turn in full on a new connection, which the router serves from the next account. Turns without previous_response_id are still resent. Verified by unit test only. Decision log 2026-10-09.

Control routes (1.0.26, src-tauri/src/proxy/control.rs): GET /switchy/accounts (per Claude/Codex: current, heldByHand, pool order with atLimit and quota) and POST /switchy/switch {app, provider} through ProviderService::switch (the card's Enable, 10-minute hold), refreshing tray and window. Verified live on installed 1.0.26: accounts listed; unknown app and unknown provider answer 400; switching gemini to its current provider answered 200 and logged the hot switch. Decision log 2026-10-09; README section Control routes.

Stopped Codex session: WSL thread 01a11f51-f2e7-7961-8e81-07f8970ee324 (cwd /home/agentcode/Worldbuilding-1628SA, unattended execute_brief run) on app-server ~/.codex/switchy-sessions/7573-1974.sock. A 'continue' turn was started at 2026-10-09 01:01:13 local by an ad-hoc script calling turn/start; that tool call showed as rejected after the user interrupted but had already reached the server, and the session then ran on cc696ff2. The documented path is codex queue per C:/Projects/agent_session_messaging.md (also in the agent_orchestration skill); I did not read it first, and the user pointed that out.

Released 1.0.25 and 1.0.26 on registered2nd/switchy (exe, msi, dmg; 1.0.26 is Latest); private origin and the public copy pushed with scripts/publish_public.sh. 1.0.26 installed on this workstation. Releases were created as a draft, files uploaded, then published.

The port-15721 test services::provider::tests::update_current_claude_provider_syncs_live_when_proxy_takeover_detected_without_backup fails whenever the installed Switchy runs; the other 726 lib tests pass.
session.latest_summary: 1.0.26 released: rotation uses the account whose weekly window ends first, Codex continuation turns refused for usage retry in full, and /switchy/accounts + /switchy/switch control the running app.

current_focus.summary: 1.0.26 is released and installed here: confirm on live traffic that rotation switches back by weekly reset and that Codex survives a usage limit mid-session, confirm the restart hand-back, and install the latest on another user's MacBook once reachable.

next_actions.summary: CONFIRM ROTATION AND CODEX FAILOVER ON LIVE TRAFFIC (1.0.25/1.0.26). In C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log and the switchy.db account_switches table: (a) when an account's five-hour window resets while another serves, a switch back to it with reason 'recovered' and detail "Another account's weekly limit resets sooner"; (b) a Codex turn refused for usage that continues an earlier one logs '[CodexWS] provider=... websocket closed (turn refused for usage; Codex resends it in full)' and the turn then completes on the next account with no error in Codex; a full-conversation turn still logs 'refused the turn for usage; sent it again on provider=...'. Long sessions should not close with 'Message too long'. GET http://127.0.0.1:15721/switchy/accounts shows current account, pool order, quota and atLimit per account (quota readings are in memory, empty after a restart until each account answers).

CONFIRM THE RESTART HAND-BACK ON A REAL WINDOWS RESTART (only simulated so far). After the user's next restart, the last lines of C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.prev.log should be 'Session ending; handing the live configs back' and 'Live configs handed back for the session end', the first start in switchy.log should have no 'Previous run exited abnormally' warning, and Claude Code opened before Switchy starts should answer instead of ECONNREFUSED. A 'timed out' line means the 4 s bound was hit (likely the WSL copies).

INSTALL ON CHELSEA'S MACBOOK when reachable (ssh chelsea-mac; doorway 20722 refused all of 2026-10-01). Copy installers/Switchy_<latest>_aarch64.dmg over, hdiutil attach, copy Switchy.app into /Applications, xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Switchy.app, open it. She signs in to each account herself; never copy a login from the user's machines. The latest is installers/Switchy_1.0.26_aarch64.dmg (also on the v1.0.26 release).

Wait for the user's feedback on 1.0.26 (Codex continuation turns after a usage limit, control routes), 1.0.25 (rotation by weekly reset), 1.0.24 (Codex 0.160 websocket, Windows-restart hand-back), 1.0.23 (Codex image generation through the proxy) and 1.0.22. When a Codex account switch happens during a running turn, confirm in C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log the line '[codex_engine] ... is mid-turn; signing it in to provider=... once it is idle' and that the turn completes; a passing fault shows '[FWD-003]' and should not switch accounts. A release is: bump the four version files, changelog section, CI=true pnpm build, commit, push origin, run scripts/publish_public.sh, run build-macos.yml on registered2nd/switchy (gh workflow run -R registered2nd/switchy), download its DMG into installers/ (git mv the old one to the new name, then copy over it) with the macOS line in the changelog section, commit, push, publish again, then release on registered2nd/switchy with the exe, msi and dmg. If gh release create fails with 5xx, create a --draft with --verify-tag, gh release upload each file, then gh release edit --draft=false --latest.

VERIFY LOCAL PROXY OFF WITH AN OPEN CODEX WINDOW. the user was asked to turn Local proxy off in Settings > Pool, then use a Codex window opened while the proxy was on. Confirm in C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log that "Proxy turned off; its listener stays up..." was logged, that the Codex window's later [Codex] requests still reached the proxy and answered, that netstat shows 127.0.0.1:15721 still LISTENING, and that Settings shows the proxy as off. Turning it back on must reuse the listener.

QUIT CASE WAITS ON STEPHEN. Quitting Switchy still breaks Codex windows opened under the proxy. He was offered a warning on quit naming the open Codex windows (small) or running the proxy as a process that outlives Switchy's window (large); he has not chosen. Build nothing until he does.
If the user directs request logging to be enabled, first make the Usage page's Turn on button apply to the running proxy, then enable it for Claude, Codex, and Gemini.
